name: Marcus Taylor
description: Prison leaver on licence navigating UC, housing, employment with DBS disclosure, and driving licence renewal

marcus.qualifications: GCSEs (5 A-C including Maths and English)
marcus.notes: Previously worked in construction. CSCS card lapsed. Needs to renew card and DBS check for site work.

financials.notes: No bank account — closed by bank during sentence. No savings. Received £46 discharge grant on release. Needs to open basic bank account for UC payments.

marcus.gpSurgery: Not yet registered (was registered at HMP Leeds healthcare)

children.notes: Age 4, lives with ex-partner Jade in Wakefield. Marcus has informal contact arrangement — sees Chloe every other Saturday at a contact centre.

family.notes: Single. Daughter Chloe lives with ex-partner Jade Matthews in Wakefield. No formal custody arrangement. Marcus's mum lives in Leeds — supportive but limited means.
supportNetwork: Prison leavers support group at St George's Centre

housing.notes: Approved premises placement — maximum 12 weeks. 6 weeks remaining. Must find permanent accommodation or faces street homelessness. Hostel address accepted for UC but not for driving licence renewal.

communicationStyle.tone: Direct, slightly guarded. Doesn't trust institutions easily — has had bad experiences. Frustrated by bureaucracy but trying to stay on the right side of things for Chloe's sake. Uses plain language.
communicationStyle.techSavvy: Moderate — comfortable with smartphones and social media. Had limited internet access in prison. Can use basic apps but hasn't navigated government websites before. No laptop — phone only.
primaryConcerns: Getting UC sorted before approved premises time runs out
Finding permanent housing — terrified of being on the streets
Getting work in construction again but worried about DBS
Renewing driving licence — needs an address and it's expired
Seeing Chloe regularly and proving he's getting his life together
typicalPhrases: I've just been released from prison and I need to sort everything out.
I've got six weeks before they kick me out of the hostel.
I want to get back into construction but I don't know if my record stops me.
My probation officer is alright but she's got like 50 other people to deal with.
I just want to see my daughter and prove I've sorted myself out.
I don't even have a bank account. How am I supposed to get UC without one?

licenceConditions: Reside at approved premises as directed
Do not travel outside England and Wales without permission
Attend all scheduled appointments with probation
justiceHistory.probationOfficer: Karen Mitchell, West Yorkshire Probation Service
justiceHistory.reportingSchedule: Fortnightly — Tuesdays 10am at Huddersfield Probation Office
restrictions: No travel outside England and Wales
